e.title_en: A claim triage application that is actually running: upload a vehicle damage image, run segmentation first, then produce a structured claim summary. Measured this round as live with real page content, and a genuine health check returned one segmentation provider as declared and a different one as active, while the readme links point at the author own machine and return 404.

e.summary: **ClaimSight**（Hugging Face Space `DavidL72Code/ClaimSight`）**是一个**在线的车损理赔分诊应用****——**逐字自述为**「**Insurance Damage Assessment Tool**」**，**并**逐字说明**它**把**图像分割**与**多模态报告生成**合在一起**（**「**An MVP for insurance claim triage that combines image segmentation with multimodal report generation.**」**）**。**本次实测**：**Docker 类型的 Space**、**创建 **2026-06-11**、**最后修改 **2026-09-10**（**⭐ 在**解冻窗口**内**）**、**⭐ 而**其 `*.hf.space` 域名**本次**实测返回 **HTTP 200** 并**取到真实页面内容****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **本次**真的调用了**它自述的健康端点**，**返回逐字**「**{"status":"ok","segmentation_provider":"gemini","active_segmentation_provider":"gemini+sam2","demo_mode":true,"attachments_enabled":true}**」**——**⭐ 即**「**你要的那个**」与**「**真正在用的那个**」**被分成两个字段**；**② **它有**降级路径**（**⭐ 逐字**「**If SAM 2 cannot load, the API still responds using the classical fallback so the demo does not hard-crash during cold starts or constrained deployments.**」**）**；**③ **安全说明里有一条**与本项目主题高度相关**：**逐字**「**Gemini prompts explicitly treat image text, filenames, and visible instructions as untrusted evidence.**」**（**⭐ 即**把**图像里的文字**当成**不可信证据**）**；**④ **⚠️ 而**同一份 README 的链接**指向**作者本机的**绝对路径**（**实测 **404****）**。**⚠️ 本次**未上传任何图片、**未调用评估接口**。

e.summary_en: This Hugging Face Space **is a working online vehicle damage claim triage application**, described verbatim as an insurance damage assessment tool that combines image segmentation with multimodal report generation. **Measured this round**: a Docker Space created in June and last modified in September, inside the thaw window, and its subdomain answered with a real application page rather than a placeholder. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that actually run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Four things are worth reading: this round actually called the health endpoint the project documents, and it returned a request naming one segmentation provider while the active provider field named two, so what was asked for and what is actually running are separate fields; the service has a documented fallback path stating that if the segmentation model cannot load the API still responds using the classical fallback so the demo does not hard-crash during cold starts or constrained deployments; the security notes contain a line highly relevant to this project, stating that the report generation prompts explicitly treat image text, file names and visible instructions as untrusted evidence; and the same readme links to an absolute path on the author own machine, which measured as a dead link.** **No image was uploaded and no assessment endpoint was called this round.**
e.body:
**ClaimSight**（Hugging Face Space `DavidL72Code/ClaimSight`）**是一个**在线的车损理赔分诊应用****——**逐字自述为**「**Insurance Damage Assessment Tool**」**，**且**逐字说明它**结合**图像分割与**多模态报告生成**（**「**An MVP for insurance claim triage that combines image segmentation with multimodal report generation.**」**）。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Hugging Face API、仓库文件与一次真实请求实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 本次真的调了一次端点，**而它把「**声明**」与「**生效**」分成两个字段****——**⭐ 本次请求** `https://davidl72code-claimsight.hf.space/api/health`**（**HTTP 200、**137 字节、**约 0.96 秒**）**，**返回逐字为**：**「**{"status":"ok","segmentation_provider":"gemini","active_segmentation_provider":"gemini+sam2","demo_mode":true,"attachments_enabled":true}**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处是本条最有价值的记录**：**⭐ 即**同一件事**有两个字段**——**「**请求的分割提供方**」是 `gemini`**，**而**「**当前生效的分割提供方**」是 `gemini+sam2`****；**⭐ 而**它的 README 逐字说明这个端点的用途**：**「**The health response includes the requested segmentation provider, active provider, SAM 2 model id, and whether the SAM 2 adapter is ready.**」**——**⭐ 故**调用者**不必**去猜**「**你以为你在用哪个模型、**而**实际跑的是哪个模型**」**。**⭐ 与本会话第 361／362 轮的纪律合读**：**登记 ≠ 可用 ≠ 完整**——**本条**补上的是**「**同一个服务内部**也有**声明与**生效之分**」**。**⭐⭐ ② 它有**明写的降级路径**，**并**说明了降级的原因****——**逐字为**「**If SAM 2 cannot load, the API still responds using the classical fallback so the demo does not hard-crash during cold starts or constrained deployments.**」**；**⭐ 并**逐字给出**模型档位的选择**：**推荐先上 **`facebook/sam2-hiera-tiny`**，**若** Space 内存足够**再升到 **`facebook/sam2-hiera-small`****，**且** `Dockerfile` 里**设了 **`INSTALL_SAM2=1`** 以便**构建期安装依赖**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组说明**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**演示的可用性**」**放在**「**模型的完整性**」之前**——**⭐ 这与**本会话多次记录过的**「**宁可**先给出**可运行的最小版本**，**而**把**失败路径写明**」**同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 安全说明里的「**不可信证据**」一条**——**`SECURITY.md` 的**已实施控制**逐条列出**（**本次实测其中若干**）**：**⭐ 不提交硬编码密钥**；**⭐ 生产镜像默认 **`APP_ENV=production`／**`DEBUG=false`／**`ENABLE_API_DOCS=false`****；**⭐ `/api/assess` 支持**可选的 **Bearer 令牌**保护**（`API_ACCESS_TOKEN`**）**；**⭐ **CORS 默认只允许显式列出的本地来源**，**除**显式开关**外**忽略通配 `*`****；**⭐ **可信主机检查**（`ALLOWED_HOSTS`**）**；**⭐ 前后端**都设**安全响应头**（**CSP、**禁止嵌入、**nosniff、**referrer 策略与**权限策略**）**；**⭐ `/api/assess` **按 **IP 限流**，**并**限制上传字节数、**像素数、**MIME、**扩展名**，**且**用 **Pillow **真验证图片****；**⭐ **上传文件名**在返回或**送模型前**被归一化**；**⭐ **健康检查**不暴露**原始异常文本**；**⭐ 以及**本词条认为**最值得抄**的一条**：**逐字**「**Gemini prompts explicitly treat image text, filenames, and visible instructions as untrusted evidence.**」**——**⭐ 即**它**明确假设**图片里的**文字**、**文件名与**画面中的**指令**都可能是**攻击面**，**而**不是**证据**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这对**任何**把**图像或 PDF** 交给**多模态模型**的理赔场景**都是**应当照抄的一句**。**⭐ 并**如实记下**它**自己划出的界限**：**`SECURITY.md` 有一节逐字为**「**Not Applicable In This MVP**」**，**说明**在**尚未加入数据库之前**，**SQL／**NoSQL 注入、**数据库权限与**备份恢复**等项**不适用****。**⭐⭐ ④ 接口面与文件结构（可核对）**：**⭐ 端点逐字含** `/health`、**`/api/health`、**`POST /api/assess`、**`POST` 与 **`GET /api/cases`、**`GET /api/cases/{case_id}`、**`GET /api/queue`（**分诊队列**）**、**`POST /api/claim-assistant`、**`POST /api/second-pass`（**二次复核**）**、**`GET /api/keepalive`、**`POST /api/attachments`****；**⭐ 服务层**共 **11 个文件**，**逐字含** `segmentation.py`、**`mobilesam.py`、**`assessment_pipeline.py`、**`gemini_client.py`、**`report_generation.py`、**`evaluation.py`、**`case_repository.py`、**`attachment_storage.py`、**`demo_reviewer.py`、**`supabase_auth.py`、**`supabase_data.py`****；**⭐ 仓库共 **30 个文件**，**且**有 **`SECURITY.md`**、**`.env.example` 与 **`Dockerfile`****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组命名**说明**它**不是**一个**单文件演示**：**它有**队列、**案件库、**附件存储、**二次复核与**评测**——**⭐ 而**其中**「**评测**」与**「**二次复核**」**是**理赔场景里**最容易被**演示版省略**的两件**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 部署形态是**前后端分离的**混合部署****——**逐字为**「**backend: FastAPI app intended for Hugging Face Spaces using Docker**」**与**「**frontend/: static app intended for Vercel**」**——**⭐ 即**模型侧在 **Space 上**，**界面**放在**另一家平台**上**，**并由 **`ALLOWED_ORIGINS`** 与 **`VITE_API_BASE_URL` **两个变量**对接**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**这类**跨平台部署**会让**「**这个应用在哪**」**变成一个**需要读文档**才能回答的问题**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 一处**可核查的坏链**：**同一份 README**在**两处**把**文件链接**写成了**作者本机的绝对路径**（**逐字形如** `/Users/davidle/Documents/Insurance%20damage%20assessment%20tool/Dockerfile`**）**——**⭐ 本次实测**该链接**在 Hub 上**返回 **404****；**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**这**不影响**应用运行**，**但**它**说明**本地预览**与**线上发布**之间的**链接检查**是**两件事**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[car-damage-assessment-ai]]、**[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、**[[claims-intake-agent]]、**[[damagerestore-claims-index]]、**[[guidewire-claim-intelligence]]、**[[claims-triage-mcp]] 覆盖**车损评估、**理赔受理与**分诊**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一个**真的在跑、**并**把**声明与**生效**分成两个字段**的**在线理赔分诊应用**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **健康检查**要能回答**「**我现在**实际用的是什么**」**，**而**不只是**「**我是否活着**」**；**② **降级路径**要**写明**，**并**说明**为什么**要**降级**（**冷启动与**资源受限**）**；**③ **凡是**把图片／PDF** 交给**多模态模型**，**就要**把**其中的文字**当作**不可信输入**；**④ **README 里的**链接**要**指向**仓库内路径或**公开地址**，**不要**指向**本机**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有上传任何图片、**没有调用 **`/api/assess`**（**未做任何损伤评估、**未生成任何理赔摘要**）**，**故**不主张**其**分割或**报告的**准确度**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只调用了**它自述的**健康端点**（**只读、**无副作用**）**——**⭐ 这也是**本会话**一贯的做法**：**只调用**自述为**只读的端点**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**分割与**报告**用的**模型是否**与**本次健康检查**所述一致**（**⭐ 只知**健康端点**自称**生效提供方为 `gemini+sam2`**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **Supabase **相关文件**（**认证与**数据**）在**本次请求中**是否**被实际使用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**仓内是否**含有**演示数据**或**真实索赔资料**（**⭐ 本次**只列了**文件清单**，**未逐一下载**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该 Space **创建于 **2026-06-11**（**窗口之外**）**，**而**最后修改为 **2026-09-10**（**窗口之内**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**一个**在线的**车损理赔分诊应用**，**其**健康端点**主动区分**「**请求的**」与「**生效的**」**模型**」这一形态**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该应用**自述为 **MVP 与**演示形态**（**健康端点**逐字返回 **`"demo_mode":true`**）**，**不得**用于**真实理赔决定**。

30 個檔案**，**並有 `SECURITY.md`、**`.env.example` 與 `Dockerfile`****。**⭐ 它**不是**單檔案演示**：**有隊列、**案件庫、**附件存儲、**二次覆核與**評測**——**⭐ 其中「**評測**」與「**二次覆核**」**是**理賠場景裡**最容易被**演示版省略**的兩件**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 部署形態是**前後端分離的混合部署****——**逐字為**「**backend: FastAPI app intended for Hugging Face Spaces using Docker**」**與**「**frontend/: static app intended for Vercel**」**——**⭐ 即**模型側在 Space**，**介面**放在**另一家平台**，**並由 `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` 與 `VITE_API_BASE_URL` 對接**；**⭐ 這類**跨平台部署**會讓**「**這個應用在哪**」**變成**需要讀文檔**才能回答的問題**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 一處**可核查的壞鏈**：**README 兩處**把檔案連結**寫成**作者本機絕對路徑**（**形如** `/Users/davidle/Documents/Insurance%20damage%20assessment%20tool/Dockerfile`**）**——**⭐ 本次實測**該連結**在 Hub 上**返回 **404****；**⭐ 這**不影響**應用運行**，**但**說明**本地預覽與線上發布之間的**連結檢查**是**兩件事**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[car-damage-assessment-ai]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、[[claims-intake-agent]]、[[damagerestore-claims-index]]、[[guidewire-claim-intelligence]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**一個真的在跑、**並把聲明與生效分成兩個欄位**的**在線理賠分診應用**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **健康檢查**要能回答**「**我現在實際用的是什麼**」**；**② **降級路徑要寫明**，**並說明原因**（**冷啟動與資源受限**）**；**③ **把圖片／PDF 交給多模態模型時**，**要把其中的文字當作不可信輸入**；**④ **README 連結**不要指向本機**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有上傳任何圖片、**沒有調用 `/api/assess`**，**不主張**其分割或報告的準確度**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只調用**它自述的**健康端點**（**只讀、**無副作用**）**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其分割與報告**用的模型**是否與**本次健康檢查所述一致**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其 Supabase 相關檔案**（**認證與數據**）是否**被實際使用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其倉內是否含**演示數據或**真實索賠資料**（**本次只列檔案清單**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**創建於 2026-06-11（**窗口之外**）**，**最後修改 2026-09-10（**窗口之內**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**在線車損理賠分診應用，**其健康端點主動區分「**請求的**」與「**生效的**」**模型**」這一形態**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該應用自述為 MVP 與演示形態**（**健康端點逐字返回 `"demo_mode":true`**）**，**不得用於真實理賠決定**。

This Hugging Face Space **is a working online vehicle damage claim triage application**, described verbatim as an insurance damage assessment tool that combines image segmentation with multimodal report generation. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that actually run, and of the several states a Space can be in.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform API, the repository files and one real request**: **first, this round actually called the health endpoint the project documents, and the response separates what was asked for from what is running.** The request to the health path returned a success status with a body naming a requested segmentation provider, a different active segmentation provider made of two names, a flag stating that demo mode is on, and a flag stating that attachments are enabled. **That is the most valuable record in this entry: the same subject appears in two fields, so a caller does not have to guess which model was requested and which is actually running, and the readme itself documents that the health response carries the requested provider, the active provider, the second model identifier and whether that adapter is ready.** **Read alongside the disciplines recorded in the earlier rounds of this session — that registration is not availability and availability is not completeness — this entry adds that a single service also distinguishes what it declares from what is in force.** **Second, the service documents a fallback path and says why it exists**, stating verbatim that if the segmentation model cannot load the API still responds using the classical fallback so the demo does not hard-crash during cold starts or constrained deployments, and it names a small model to start with and a larger one to move to when memory allows, while the container installs the heavy dependencies at build time by default. **Together those show availability of the demonstration taking priority over completeness of the model.** **Third, the security notes contain the line most worth copying in this entry**: the report generation prompts explicitly treat image text, file names and visible instructions as untrusted evidence. **That is the sentence to reuse whenever an image or a document is handed to a multimodal model in a claims setting.** The same file lists the controls actually implemented, including no hardcoded credentials, production defaults that disable debug mode and the interactive API documentation, optional bearer token protection, cross-origin rules that ignore the wildcard unless explicitly allowed, trusted host checking, security headers, per-address rate limits together with upload byte, pixel, MIME and extension limits and real image verification, normalised upload file names, and health checks that do not expose raw exception text. **It also draws its own boundary in a section stating which risks are not applicable until a database is added.** **Fourth, the interface and file structure are checkable**: the routes include health, an assessment endpoint, case creation, listing and retrieval, a triage queue, a claim assistant, a second-pass review, a keepalive and an attachments endpoint; the service layer holds eleven files covering segmentation, a mobile segmentation adapter, the assessment pipeline, the language model client, report generation, evaluation, case storage, attachment storage, a demonstration reviewer and two authentication and data modules; and the repository holds thirty files including a security policy, an environment template and a container definition. **That naming shows this is not a single-file demonstration: it has a queue, a case store, attachment storage, a second review pass and an evaluation step, and the last two are precisely what demonstration versions usually omit.** **Fifth, deployment is split across two platforms**, the model side on a Docker Space and the interface as a static application intended for a different host, joined by allowed-origins and base-url variables, **which is worth noting because in such a layout the question of where the application actually lives can only be answered by reading the documentation**. **Sixth, one broken link is checkable**: the readme links two repository files through absolute paths on the author own machine, and those links return 404 on the platform, which does not affect the running application but shows that local preview and published links are two different checks. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover vehicle damage assessment, a damage detector, claim intake, a claims index, claim intelligence and claims triage, **while this entry supplies a live online claim triage application that separates what it was asked for from what is in force. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: make the health check answer what is actually in use, not merely whether the service is alive; document the fallback path and why it exists; treat text inside images and documents as untrusted input whenever they reach a multimodal model; and never point readme links at a local machine.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no image was uploaded and the assessment endpoint was not called**, so no damage assessment was produced and no claim summary generated, **and no claim is made about the accuracy of either**. **Second, only the health endpoint the project itself documents was called, a read-only route with no side effects, consistent with this session practice of calling only endpoints described as read-only.** **Third, whether the models actually used for segmentation and reporting match what the health check reported was not verified**, only that the endpoint reports a two-part active provider. **Fourth, whether the authentication and data modules are actually in use was not verified. Fifth, whether the repository contains demonstration data or real claim material was not verified**, only the file list being read. **Sixth, on the window: the Space was created in June, outside the window, and last modified in September, inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a live vehicle damage claim triage application whose health endpoint distinguishes the requested model from the one in force. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the application describes itself as a demonstration, the health endpoint returning a demo-mode flag, and must not be used for real claim decisions.**
